scope: Actual arm64 iOS Release bounded control flow of owned pointer assignment begin/finish/disposal, context/scene receipts, generic setter/update borrowed gates, and Python conversion. Native poststate bodies are reviewed separately.

artifact_correction.finding: Case-insensitive Windows filename collision between rna_property_update.asm and RNA_property_update.asm overwrote the internal-function dump with the public wrapper. Actual symbols and JSON boundaries are distinct; no production defect follows.
artifact_correction.repair: Watcher now includes group, numeric actual start address and selector in filename. Repaired31 dump paths are unique after casefold; all14 outer review dumps match independent actual instruction digests.

findings.area: Exact owned entry and copied values
findings.result: Entry clears output receipt, selects exact profile and checks target/value/output, TLS busy/lease, G_MAIN and initial absence. Both PointerRNA scalar triples plus their ancestor vectors are copied into the heap receipt; actual copy_assign_container calls at0x10124a8f0/0x10124a910 precede state_create0x10124a93c. State/context creation failure returns NativeBaseline only when initially absent; otherwise refuses. No Main or Scene provider is called before state/context capture.

Context capture checks G_MAIN, live WM/window/screen membership, nonzero manager/screen UIDs and winid/runtime, active screen and area/region membership. It stores caller/BPY context, Main, WM/window/screen, sizes, area/region/runtime/type and every scene as a0x48-byte typed receipt. Scene capture at0x10124aecc requires SC type; ID capture searches Main and requires exactly one address match/nonzero UID before reading ID metadata, separately validates library LI UID and override reference/root UID/type. Equality checks vector length and every named field, not padding/memcmp. Context recapture/equality is actual; no global allocator lifetime proof is claimed.

findings.area: Owner drain and supplied Main provider
findings.result: Owner-present branch starts256-attempt loop. receipt_matches0x10124ab44 must pass before CTX_data_main0x10124ab50. Caller Main equality plus receipt_matches0x10124ab68 must pass before null-C WM_next0x10124ab88 with did-output/policy1(MaterialAssignmentOriginal). Every successful WM call revalidates receipt at0x10124ab98 before did flag is loaded at0x10124aba0; didfalse exits only after that validation. Final receipt+absence query at0x10124a98c/0x10124a9b0 precede lease/set. No supplied-context Main provider is hidden inside this producer shared scan; the null-C original-owner policy itself is outside this outer review.

Fresh property resolution then Set-phase lease captures original owner/data/type/property/profile, installs TLS lease and calls generic setter0x10124aa14 on receipt-owned target and value copy. Clears TLS lease immediately afterward. Requires outer/native-consumed flags, no reports error, context match and static property resolution before state_mark_applied0x10124aa94. Only success publishes receipt and returns enum2. Refusal clears busy/lease then frees receipt; exception landing paths also clear scopes and dispose. Failed apply/finish is not rollback.

findings.area: Late finish provider ordering and single use
findings.result: Null/finished/busy/lease refuse. Marks receipt.finished at0x10124b7f8 before provider work. Receipt match0x10124b808 precedes Main provider0x10124b814; compares returned Main and revalidates0x10124b830 then absence0x10124b854 before Scene provider0x10124b860. Receipt match0x10124b870, null-or-captured-scene membership loop0x10124b878-8a0 and absence0x10124b8fc must pass before fresh property, Update-phase TLS lease and complete internal update0x10124b95c. Afterward checks both consumption flags and clears TLS/busy on return or exception; a second finish refuses before providers.

findings.area: Generic setter first gate and Release native admission
findings.result: outer_admit0x10124b134 is before IDProperty resolution, type work or setter. Matching original tuple/property/profile/phase with unconsumed outer lease consumes once; unmatched/busy/lease/owner-present refuses. Existing material gate0x10124b280 precedes immediate native_ready0x10124b2b8, native argument copy and indirect setter0x10124b370. Nonnull/self checks still precede native-ready. This actual package is Release: Debug getter/refcount code is compiled out; its source position after material absence and before native-ready is source-only evidence.

Lease_matches is inlined at0x101256ed4-0x101256f2c and0x101257020-0x101257074, comparing owner/data/type/property/profile/phase. Outer consumed byte is set at0x101256f3c. Native-ready first checks absence via null-C/no-output/policy0 WM query0x101257000, then matching tuple, consumed outer, unconsumed native, unarmed ready before setting ready at0x1012570d4. Unleased initially-absent baseline requires no busy flag. Actual native consumer side is separate review.

borrowed_update is inlined in actual public wrapper, not missing. Exact profile busy/lease/absence gates0x10125199c-0x101251a04 return before any Main/Scene provider when refused. Absent supported target copy owns ancestor storage0x101251a08-0x101251a8c; state/context capture precede busy0x101251ba4 and Main0x101251bac. Actual valid lambda checks property/profile/context/state at0x101260b90. Main equality+valid+absence precede Scene0x101251bec; valid+scene membership+absence precede Update lease and internal update0x101251ca8. Refused supported paths return after owned cleanup. Unsupported initially-absent state/context shapes deliberately fall through after cleanup to baseline Main0x101251d0c and Scene0x101251d18. This bounded baseline is not a universal ownership guarantee.

findings.area: Internal C and messagebus update preserved
findings.result: Actual internal function first calls outer_admit at0x10124ba14 then material owner-absence gate0x10124bae4. Non-context native callback is armed only by native_ready0x10124bb10 before callback through prop+0x88 at0x10124bb48. Existing context-specific callback split0x10124bb2c-50 remains. Successful callback continues to notifier0x10124bb60, CTX_wm_message_bus0x10124bb6c and WM_msg_publish_rna0x10124bb78 when C nonnull, and DEG_id_tag_update0x10124bd84 when applicable; IDProperty branch retains recalc/notifier/relations updates. RNA_property_update_main passes null C to this same complete function and therefore remains covered by internal first gate. No manual shortened update replaces C/messagebus semantics.

findings.area: Python original ownership and enum branches
findings.result: ReportList init0x101509574 and exact profile check0x10150957c precede target/value PointerRNA copy constructors0x10150958c/0x1015095a8 at stack0x170/0x118. Saved BPY context0x1015095ac is used for begin0x1015095c8. Post-begin BPY equality0x1015095d0-8 is checked before result branching. Enums0/1 alone reach generic fallback0x10150983c on original ptr but copied value; enum3 reports/refuses; enum2 skips fallback. Pointer copy body0x10124a34c copies scalar triple and independent16-byte ancestor loop/reserve, not merely the Python optional wrapper. Report conversion0x101509884 gates tail and decref cleanup; interpreter-wide lifetimes remain outside scope.

findings.area: Python late finish, no stale wrapper update, disposal
findings.result: Non-null receipt branches before generic update_check/property wrapper. BPY context mismatch errors to common cleanup; equality initializes separate reports and calls finish0x1015088b0 using saved context/receipt. Reports error or false finish refuses; successful finish reaches return without rereading former ptr/property for generic update. No-receipt baseline alone calls update_check0x10150879c/public update0x1015087b0. Copied local ancestors are destroyed0x101509864/86c before report conversion/tail; common normal/error exit calls receipt_free0x101509520, and exception tail calls receipt_free0x1015099cc.

findings.area: Context-free receipt disposal and alias resolution
findings.result: receipt_free null-checks, calls state_free0x10124a70c, deletes scene vector storage then value/target owned ancestor allocations only and deletes receipt. No context provider, original ID dereference or update callback is called by this destructor. Target0x100013e10 is a156-name folded alias including exact PointerRNA destructor; actual body reads only its own ancestor storage, conditional MEM_freeN, and return. Disassembler chosen FillToolTargetInfo label is not a sculpt callback. Lease_matches/absent/scene_matches are inlined; borrowed_update has no standalone body but its exact validator lambda is resolved. Overloads were selected by exact mangled symbols and next greater text address.

debug_source_only.claim: Material borrowed absence gate precedes Debug old/new getter/refcount reads; native_ready is after Debug getter work and immediate before native setter. Debug binary behavior is not established by this Release review.

limitations: No full heap/allocator/ABA proof, global control-flow or arbitrary callback/reentrancy/interpreter proof.
No independent proof of shared WM original-owner reconstruction, native setter poststate or all WindowManager callbacks; those are separate reviews.
No UIKit, GPU, Pencil input, device execution or device acceptance.
Initially-absent unsupported state/context shapes explicitly retain native baseline; receipt refusal after mutation is not rollback.
